verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API client and testing platform. Its CLI mentions running tests and 'automated API monitoring', which makes the monitoring axis applicable. That is scripted collection runs with JUnit reports, though, not monitoring of live API traffic. The pack documents no metrics, logging or tracing integrations; enterprise audit logs are an adjacent admin feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor API traffic with metrics, logging, and tracing integrations
